title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer thresholds and regional failover ordering
author: Aisha Patel
description: Root cause: during a regional failover under high request churn the SLO enforcer could oscillate and over-shed capacity. The immediate trigger was a race between threshold smoothing recalculation and the regional failover controller: smoothing updates were applied out-of-order across regions and could transiently lower thresholds for a region that was already in the process of failing over, which caused aggressive load-shedding and cascading failovers. This PR fixes the ordering and makes smoothing monotonic with a smaller responsive window plus hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping. Changes are conservative and guarded by feature-flagged rollout in production.
summary_commits:
fix(slo): make threshold smoothing monotonic and add hysteresis
fix(region): serialize regional failover ordering to avoid cross-region races
test(slo): add deterministic race-condition unit + integration tests
chore(monitoring): emit new metrics for smoothing decisions and rollback hints
docs(release): add hotfix notes and rollout instructions
review_comments:
Chen Li: Can you explain why the smoothing window was reduced from 60s to 30s? We saw oscillation in canary earlier.
Aisha: Reduced window to 30s for faster response to sudden load but added a 15s hysteresis and monotonic clamp to prevent threshold decreases while a region is draining.
Marco Ruiz: Requested a serialization primitive in the failover controller to guarantee ordering across region controllers — added a lightweight region-order lock.
Emily Dawson: Asked for additional metric to detect 'smoothing flip' — added smoothing_decision_count and smoothing_clamp_events.
Chen Li: Approves after tests pass. Marco approved and merged via squash.

release_notes:
- Hotfix: SLO enforcer smoothing now monotonic and includes hysteresis to prevent oscillation during regional failover.
- Fix: serialized regional failover ordering to avoid cross-region threshold race conditions.
- Added metrics: smoothing_decision_count, smoothing_clamp_events.
- Tests: new unit and integration tests covering enforcer/failover races.
Deployment notes: feature-flagged rollout; follow SRE runbook SRE-1120 if any regressions are observed.
notes_for_ops: Rollout plan: enable feature flag slo.enforcer.v2 on canary (us-west-2) for 30m, observe smoothing_decision_count and smoothing_clamp_events; if clamp_events > 5/min, pause rollout and revert flag. If safe, promote to 25% (multi-region) then 100%. Backout: revert feature flag and redeploy previous enforcer image. Incident link: SUP-2219.
local_test_instructions: Run 'go test ./services/slo -run TestRaceCondition -count=10' and 'go test ./services/region -run TestFailoverOrdering'. Integration: make test-integration SLO_ENFORCER_FLAG=true. CI reproducer steps included in tests/slo/README.md.
safety_checks: Added load-shedding safety guard: never drop below 10% of baseline capacity for regions with active long-running flows. Updated helm values with slo.min_capacity_pct. Added integration test that asserts no region drops below min capacity during simulated failover.
